subject.title: fix(shared): bound ignore-file reads during workspace scans

question: Should workspace scanning adopt a fixed 4 MiB ignore-file cap whose oversize behavior terminally hides the affected subtree rather than attempting partial parsing or continuing discovery?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically focused, but the threshold and terminal exclusion intentionally change what existing workspaces discover; only a core owner can accept that upgrade behavior.

options.title: Accept bounded fail-closed scanning
options.body: Approve the 4 MiB cap and terminal subtree exclusion, then require refreshed current-head real-scan proof before merge.

options.title: Revise the policy boundary
options.body: Choose a different fixed cap or oversize handling contract before landing, with matching tests and updated user-impact proof.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded fail-closed scanning
recommendation.body: Approve the 4 MiB cap and terminal subtree exclusion, then require refreshed current-head real-scan proof before merge.
